evals.name: ko-genai-trends-blue
evals.prompt: 생성형 AI 최신 동향 보고서 만들어줘. 자료 조사해서 워드(docx) 파일로 저장해주고, 메인 컬러는 파랑으로 해줘.
evals.expected_output: Korean Word report on recent generative-AI trends with a summary, sectioned body, a table, and a numbered source list with real URLs; blue main color; title 40px, body 20px, 맑은 고딕.

evals.name: ko-jeju-trip-red
evals.prompt: 제주도 3박 4일 여행 정보 문서 만들어줘. 인터넷에서 조사해서 docx로 출력하고, 색상은 빨강 계열로 부탁해.
evals.expected_output: Korean Word travel-information document for a 3-night 4-day Jeju trip (itinerary, costs, timing, tips) with a table and sources; red main color; required type sizes and font.

evals.name: en-solid-state-batteries-green
evals.prompt: Research the current state of solid-state batteries and write it up as a Word report. Use green as the main color.
evals.expected_output: English Word report on solid-state batteries (players, timelines, technical hurdles) with summary, table, and sources with real URLs; green main color; required type sizes and font.
